body:
Add the Nesting browser row, property panel, sheet layout preview, material use readout, and per-profile cut-side controls in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/`.

Depends on #2160 (and uses `#1863` / `#1880` DXF and SVG sketch imports).

## Scope

- **Browser tree and panel (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/`):**
  - Follow `crates/ui/AGENTS.md`: route every mutation through `crates/app` commands (`CreateNest`, `EditNest`, `AddNestPart`, `RemoveNestPart`, `SetNestProfileSide`, `RunNesting`, `DeleteNest`), use `layout/form.rs` and `fields.rs` helpers, and keep new files under ~400 lines.
  - Add a Nesting node in `browser_tree.rs` and an editor page for sheet width, height, material/thickness preset picker (reading `#1886` / `#1521` cut data), kerf or router tool diameter, part gap, edge margin, rotation mode, mirror toggle, parts-in-holes toggle, and router holding options (tabs, onion skin, vacuum).
  - List selected parts (`Sketch` entities from DXF `#1452` or SVG `#1880`, and 3D models `STEP`/`STL`/`OBJ`/`.sc`) with quantity, sheet-face pick (`3D`), rotation/mirror overrides, default cut side (`Inside`, `OnLine`, `Outside`), and per-profile chain cut-side overrides (`Inside`, `OnLine`, `Outside`, `Left`, `Right`).
  - Provide one "Nest" button that triggers `RunNesting`.
- **Layout output and viewport preview:**
  - Show `sheet_count`, per-sheet placed counts per model (`N of PartA, M of PartB`), per-sheet and total `utilization_pct`, remaining sheet area, inside-corner radius warnings, and any unplaced part refusal messages by name.
  - Provide sheet selector tabs (`Sheet 1`, `Sheet 2`, ...) and render placed part outlines, cut-side colors, waste skeleton overlay, and numbered cut-order markers in the viewport.

## Done means

Structural UI tests in `crates/ui` verify the Nest browser row, sheet/material/spacing/part editors, cut-side and quantity controls, one-button Nest command dispatch, sheet tabs, per-sheet part counts, utilization % and sheet count readouts, and unplaced-part refusal display without modifying snapshot PNGs.

Part of #2156
